run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.rmcp_shared_router_seam: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 exposes a safer policy-parity seam: route every CallTool through ToolRouter.call, then implement task creation inside the registered handler. ToolRouter preserves disabled-route and route lookup, while standard ToolCallContext extraction supplies RequestContext, Parameters, RequestState and InputResponses before handler materialization.
run_findings.rmcp_bundled_demo_boundary: Bundled TaskDemo still branches slow_sum to TaskManager.spawn before ToolRouter fallback, so ToolRouter-local disabled/configuration semantics are not mechanically inherited by the task-backed branch. This is a structural parity boundary, not a claim of a demonstrated exploit.
run_findings.rmcp_post_handler_capability_guard: Generic server request handling checks whether a returned Task response is allowed by client Tasks capability only after self.call_tool completes. Therefore the generic guard alone cannot prevent a custom handler from materializing a task first; a task-capable handler must enforce capability before spawn. Bundled TaskDemo does perform that local precheck.
run_findings.rmcp_stock_task_boundary: Bundled TaskManager remains in-memory with fresh UUID task IDs. Lost CreateTaskResult blind retry, stable create-or-get, server-restart recovery and persistent redrive are not established for the stock path; custom server/storage implementations are a separate possibility.
run_findings.rmcp_model: The source-equivalent router/preflight model passes 12/12 fixtures covering router-disable bypass, router-first blocking, standard extraction, pre-spawn capability/preflight/state/policy gates, generic post-guard lateness, stock lost-response duplication, restart loss and separate external-effect idempotency.
run_findings.openhands_r7_carry: OpenHands v1.44.1 R7 remains an unresolved continuation: pure marker/event/generation/head validation, off-object final snapshot, one guarded LocalFileStore atomic write, silent bookkeeping sync and cleanup; arbitrary custom FileStore atomicity and full power-loss durability must not be assumed.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All source inspection, source-equivalent harnessing and role-local persistence were Chat-native, used no finite paid/trial/monthly quota feature and had zero incremental monetary cost. Persistent custom MCP runtime/storage, compile-tested upstream refactor and OpenHands patch execution remain unresolved children.

exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap authoritative DESIRED_STATE and own config. If still active, read own LATEST and latest checkpoint only. At exact rmcp-v3.1.4, build a compile-target router-registered task handler fixture where ServerHandler::call_tool always enters ToolRouter and slow_sum accepts standard RequestContext + Parameters + RequestState + InputResponses; prove disabled, malformed, missing-Tasks, preflight, invalid-state and policy-revoked cases cannot materialize a task. Confirm the exact macro/IntoCallToolResult return shape for CallToolResponse::Task and InputRequiredResult without bespoke parser glue. Keep stock TaskManager persistence, lost-response create-or-get, restart redrive and external-effect fencing separate. Then resume OpenHands v1.44.1 R7 single-snapshot helper with a negative non-atomic custom FileStore case. Do not count external server residency or upstream patch application as Phase-1 acceptance.
